# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For this modernization request, upgrade only projects under BackendAPI and exclude UI projects for now.
- ATS should remain within the unified OnePlatform UX (not a separate sub-app/tab), and ATS pages must share the same authentication/session lifecycle so logout from OnePlatform also logs out ATS.
- In ATS dialog UI updates, use a cleaner layout with no decorative background images/gradients and no redundant duplicate headers.
